name: Databento (historical)
note: Databento meters historical data by uncompressed binary size regardless of delivered format. Rate depends on dataset and schema; enter yours.

name: Amazon S3 (data transfer out)
note: Data transfer out to the internet is billed per GB on bytes transferred (compressed if compressed). Billed to the bucket owner. Tiered; enter your effective rate.

name: Google Cloud Storage (egress)
note: Network egress billed per GB on bytes transferred, to the bucket owner. Enter your effective rate.

name: Cloudflare R2
note: R2 egress to the internet is free; repeats cost bandwidth and time, not dollars.

name: Vercel (bandwidth)
note: Fast Data Transfer is billed per GB to the site operator, not to the visitor. Only meaningful if you operate the site.

name: Stripe API
note: Stripe charges per payment, not per API byte. Repetition here is bandwidth and time, never a Stripe fee.

name: OpenAI API
note: Billed per input and output token, with cached-input discounts. Response bytes are not the billing unit.

name: Anthropic API
note: Billed per input and output token, with prompt caching. Response bytes are not the billing unit.

name: Polygon.io
note: Flat subscription tiers; repetition is bandwidth and time, not a per-byte fee.

name: GitHub API
note: Rate-limited, not metered by bytes for most plans.
